registry_quantity: Registered primary-completion date minus start date
reason: Primary completion includes accrual and follow-up; assessment time is measured from individual enrollment.

registry_quantity: One minus completed/started in posted participant flow
reason: Noncompletion and missing measurements are different events; oncology flow can include death and progression.

registry_quantity: Participant incidence during the registered adverse-event window
native_quantity: Recorded events during native clinical follow-up
reason: Exposure windows, event definitions and safety ascertainment are not aligned.

registry_quantity: Heterogeneous posted endpoint values, units, time windows and analysis populations
native_quantity: Family-specific risk, restricted mean time, terminal outcome or rate contrast
reason: No source-level adjudication aligns each registry estimand to the native target; proportional-hazard effects cannot validate marginal risk or time contrasts.

native_quantity: Generated participant-level baseline distributions and dependence
reason: The registry projection has no matching joint participant distributions; demographic or dependence realism is not evaluated.
The calibration source cannot validate synthetic causal truth or establish transfer to real-world patients.
